description: I will always do the easiest thing possible #selflove #patience #selfleadership
transcript: When people say things like, oh, that must be easy for you. Well, yes, 95% of the time only do what's easy for me. Why would I spend my life suffering focusing on things that aren't working? I am going to utilize my best resources. I am going to utilize my best tools. I have the skills. I have been fine-tuned. I know how I operate, and why would I do things that are hard just to say I did them? I have been fine-tuned.
